title: Discovery team config
description: Schema for a repository's docs/conventions/discovery.yaml, the team layer of the discovery plugin's settings. A key set here wins over the plugin's userConfig value of the same name. Keys and resolution: plugins/discovery/reference/config.md.

explore_output.description: What /discovery:explore replies with after it writes EXPLORE.md. auto: explain for a person asking how something works, change-prep otherwise. change-prep: the handoff summary for the next stage. explain: a walkthrough with file:line citations.
